title: vcd-bayesian-evidence-analysis analysis_config.json
description: Pass 0 produces this flat JSON config for Pass 1 analysis.R.

response_var.description: Optional response/outcome variable. For 3+ dimensions, Cramer's V is computed on predictor-level combinations by response_var.

output_dir.description: Pass 1 output root. analysis.R writes run_<prefix>/ below this directory.

run_id.description: Run identifier before run_<first 16 chars> output isolation.

base_models.description: Base Poisson log-linear models for multi-baseline 4-axis cell diagnostics (e.g. ['M1', 'M5']).

base_model.description: Legacy single base model specifier (normalized into base_models).

numerator_levels.description: One or more target response levels to include in the numerator.

denominator_levels.description: One or more response levels defining the denominator (superset of numerator_levels).

compare_by.description: Variable column name defining comparison groups (e.g. Gender).

stratify_by.description: Variable column name defining stratification slices (e.g. Dept).

interval_level.description: Credible interval coverage level (e.g. 0.95 for 95% ETI).

reference_level.description: Optional reference level of compare_by variable for rate difference calculations.

conditional_rate_view.description: Specification for generic conditional Bayesian rate and difference inference.
